content: प्रतिसर {%a.%} Dependent, subject. .{@-रः, -रम्@} .²1 A cord or ribbon worn round the wrist or neck as an amulet. .²2 An ornament. .²3 A watch, guard. .²4 Assailing, an attack. .{@-रः@} .²1 A servant, follower; विजये त्वर्यतां लेखः प्रतिसराय <ls>Pratijñā.</ls> .²2 A bracelet, marriage-string; स्रस्तोरगप्रतिसरेण करेण पाणिः (अगृह्यत) <ls>Ki. 5. 33</ls>; (= कौतुकसूत्र); <ls>Māl. 5. 18</ls>. .²3 A garland, wreath. .²4 Day-break. .²5 The rear of an army. .²6 A form of incantation. .²7 Healing or dressing a wound. .{@-रा@} .²1 A female servant. .²2 A thread, fillet; प्रतिसरया तुरगाणां भल्लातकशालिकुण्ठसिद्धार्थं कण्ठेषु निवध्नीयात्.
